finding.headline: "The Hot-Weather Wardrobe"
finding.problem: "The checklist said 5 sleepers and a cardigan. It's 34°C. He's sweating and breaking out. What do babies actually wear in this heat?"
finding.person: Lagos mum buying UK-style fleece sleepers; baby gets heat rash; doesn't know light breathable local-appropriate layering.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module (Nigeria-specific clothing) — strong local diff.". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
